properties.name: spring.pulsar.admin.authentication.param
properties.description: Authentication parameter(s) as a map of parameter names to parameter values.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.admin.authentication.plugin-class-name
properties.description: Fully qualified class name of the authentication plugin.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.admin.connection-timeout
properties.description: Duration to wait for a connection to server to be established.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.admin.read-timeout
properties.description: Server response read time out for any request.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.admin.request-timeout
properties.description: Server request time out for any request.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.admin.service-url
properties.description: Pulsar web URL for the admin endpoint in the format '(http|https)://host:port'.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.authentication.param
properties.description: Authentication parameter(s) as a map of parameter names to parameter values.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.authentication.plugin-class-name
properties.description: Fully qualified class name of the authentication plugin.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.connection-timeout
properties.description: Duration to wait for a connection to a broker to be established.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.failover.backup-clusters
properties.description: List of backup clusters. The backup cluster is chosen in the sequence of the given list. If all backup clusters are available, the Pulsar client chooses the first backup cluster.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.failover.check-interval
properties.description: Frequency of performing a probe task.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.failover.delay
properties.description: Delay before the Pulsar client switches from the primary cluster to the backup cluster.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.failover.policy
properties.description: Cluster failover policy.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.failover.switch-back-delay
properties.description: Delay before the Pulsar client switches from the backup cluster to the primary cluster.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.lookup-timeout
properties.description: Client lookup timeout.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.operation-timeout
properties.description: Client operation timeout.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.service-url
properties.description: Pulsar service URL in the format '(pulsar|pulsar+ssl)://host:port'.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.threads.io
properties.description: Number of threads to be used for handling connections to brokers.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.client.threads.listener
properties.description: Number of threads to be used for message listeners.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.dead-letter-policy.dead-letter-topic
properties.description: Name of the dead topic where the failing messages will be sent.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.dead-letter-policy.initial-subscription-name
properties.description: Name of the initial subscription of the dead letter topic. When not set, the initial subscription will not be created. However, when the property is set then the broker's 'allowAutoSubscriptionCreation' must be enabled or the DLQ producer will fail.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.dead-letter-policy.max-redeliver-count
properties.description: Maximum number of times that a message will be redelivered before being sent to the dead letter queue.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.dead-letter-policy.retry-letter-topic
properties.description: Name of the retry topic where the failing messages will be sent.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.name
properties.description: Consumer name to identify a particular consumer from the topic stats.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.priority-level
properties.description: Priority level for shared subscription consumers.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.read-compacted
properties.description: Whether to read messages from the compacted topic rather than the full message backlog.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.retry-enable
properties.description: Whether to auto retry messages.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.subscription.initial-position
properties.description: Position where to initialize a newly created subscription.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.subscription.mode
properties.description: Subscription mode to be used when subscribing to the topic.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.subscription.name
properties.description: Subscription name for the consumer.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.subscription.topics-mode
properties.description: Determines which type of topics (persistent, non-persistent, or all) the consumer should be subscribed to when using pattern subscriptions.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.subscription.type
properties.description: Subscription type to be used when subscribing to a topic.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.topics
properties.description: Topics the consumer subscribes to.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.consumer.topics-pattern
properties.description: Pattern for topics the consumer subscribes to.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.defaults.topic.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable default tenant and namespace support for topics.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.defaults.topic.namespace
properties.description: Default namespace to use when producing or consuming messages against a non-fully-qualified topic URL.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.defaults.topic.tenant
properties.description: Default tenant to use when producing or consuming messages against a non-fully-qualified topic URL.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.defaults.type-mappings
properties.description: List of mappings from message type to topic name and schema info to use as a defaults when a topic name and/or schema is not explicitly specified when producing or consuming messages of the mapped type.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.function.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable function support.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.function.fail-fast
properties.description: Whether to stop processing further function creates/updates when a failure occurs.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.function.propagate-failures
properties.description: Whether to throw an exception if any failure is encountered during server startup while creating/updating functions.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.function.propagate-stop-failures
properties.description: Whether to throw an exception if any failure is encountered during server shutdown while enforcing stop policy on functions.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.listener.concurrency
properties.description: Number of threads used by listener container.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.listener.observation-enabled
properties.description: Whether to record observations for when the Observations API is available and the client supports it.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.listener.schema-type
properties.description: SchemaType of the consumed messages.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.access-mode
properties.description: Type of access to the topic the producer requires.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.batching-enabled
properties.description: Whether to automatically batch messages.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable caching in the PulsarProducerFactory.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.cache.expire-after-access
properties.description: Time period to expire unused entries in the cache.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.cache.initial-capacity
properties.description: Initial size of cache.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.cache.maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum size of cache (entries).

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.chunking-enabled
properties.description: Whether to split large-size messages into multiple chunks.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.compression-type
properties.description: Message compression type.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.hashing-scheme
properties.description: Message hashing scheme to choose the partition to which the message is published.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.message-routing-mode
properties.description: Message routing mode for a partitioned producer.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.name
properties.description: Name for the producer. If not assigned, a unique name is generated.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.send-timeout
properties.description: Time before a message has to be acknowledged by the broker.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.producer.topic-name
properties.description: Topic the producer will publish to.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.reader.name
properties.description: Reader name.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.reader.read-compacted
properties.description: Whether to read messages from a compacted topic rather than a full message backlog of a topic.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.reader.subscription-name
properties.description: Subscription name.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.reader.subscription-role-prefix
properties.description: Prefix of subscription role.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.reader.topics
properties.description: Topics the reader subscribes to.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.template.observations-enabled
properties.description: Whether to record observations for when the Observations API is available.

properties.name: spring.pulsar.transaction.enabled
properties.description: Whether transaction support is enabled.
